title: Expenses of court proceeding.
bodyText: Whenever a circuit court certifies that there was probable cause for issuing a citation and taking proceedings under this chapter, the director of finance shall pay from the tax reserve fund provided in section 231-23(c)(2), or allow, all expenses incurred for services of citation and other lawful disbursements that have not otherwise been paid.
bodyHtml:
[§236D-16]  Expenses of court proceeding.  Whenever a circuit court certifies that there was probable cause for issuing a citation and taking proceedings under this chapter, the director of finance shall pay from the tax reserve fund provided in section 231-23(c)(2), or allow, all expenses incurred for services of citation and other lawful disbursements that have not otherwise been paid. [L 1983, c 217, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  Section "231-23(c)(2)" substituted for "231-23(d)(2)" pursuant to §23G-15.
